# climate-health-workdays cache

Raw public-source responses for this program are regenerated by the scripts
under `climate-health-workdays/scripts/`.

For the report 14 source-readiness audit, run:

```bash
python climate-health-workdays/scripts/audit-labor-heat-source-readiness.py
```

That script recreates `.cache/labor-heat-source-readiness/` with World Bank
WDI and World Bank CCKP JSON responses, records SHA-256 hashes in the generated
JSON artifact, and writes the committed CSV/JSON companions under
`climate-health-workdays/generated/`.
